subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR require latest-head real behavior proof for the legacy no-code SQLite upgrade path before merge, or may maintainers accept the source and test proof as sufficient?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but the legacy fallback changes persisted upgrade behavior and the external proof gate cannot be cleared from tests alone without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require Upgrade Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds on the latest head.

options.title: Accept Source/Test Proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally waive the external proof gap and accept the focused regression tests plus source inspection for this upgrade path.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup
options.body: If runtime invalidation is not the desired upgrade boundary, pause this PR and move no-code cleanup into doctor or migration-owned code.

recommendation.title: Require Upgrade Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds on the latest head.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc provided the predecessor’s explicit-marker direction and is the clearest owner for whether this satisfies that review requirement.
